reply.text:
I can't give you a yes or no on that, and I won't put an amount on it. Pre-workouts are mostly stimulants, often caffeine plus other ingredients, and stacking two means doubling up on things you may not be tracking, since labels and formulas vary a lot. That's a question for a doctor or a dietitian, who can look at what's in the products and your own situation.

On the training side, if you feel you need two to get through a session, that's usually a sign to look at sleep, food and how hard the week has been. I'm glad to help you build a session that fits your energy.
